By operating within the vehicle’s native digital interface, 4screen leverages dynamic car data to enhance the mobility experience – all in full compliance with the highest safety and privacy standards. 4screen is integrated into the operating systems of 16 leading automotive brands, including Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Volkswagen, Toyota, Kia, Hyundai, and Stellantis. Today, more than 100 brands – including McDonald’s, Shell, and Waitrose – across 12 countries are already using the platform to reach drivers in meaningful, high-intent moments. Our team at 4screen consists of a mix of young talents and industry experts that have previously been in leading positions at companies like BMW, Google or BCG. We are building a highly innovative company where everything is dynamic, disruptive, and exciting - and that you can be part of! Are you ready to join the ride and shape the future of mobility? jobs.title: Lead AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Unsere Opportunity Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche. Deine Mission Du verantwortest das Produkt auf beiden Ebenen: das bestehende ESG-Produkt weiterentwickeln und die nächste Evolutionsstufe mitgestalten, den AI-Analysten für Asset Manager, Credit Officers und Transaction Manager. Du berichtest direkt an unser Gründer-/Führungsteam und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kunden und internen Teams zusammen. Du bist verantwortlich für Kundennutzen und Umsatz, nicht für Features. Du gehst zum Kunden mit, verstehst ihre Welt, und übersetzt das in validierte Prototypen und klare Build-Entscheidungen. Was du konkret tust Own strategic product development: Du gehst raus zu unseren Kunden, verstehst ihre Prozesse sowie pain points, die sie selbst ohne dein Zutun nicht erwähnen. Du baust eigenverantwortlich Produkte, die die Nachhaltigkeit von Immobilien fördern und einen messbaren finanziellen Impact auf unsere Kunden und unser Produkt haben. Collaborate closely: Du arbeitest mit direkter Reporting-Linie zu Gründer-/ Führungsteam sowie einem starken Engineering-Team zusammen und erhältst jegliche Unterstützung, um die richtigen Produkte schnell an den Kunden zu bringen. Iterate fast, finish fully: Du erstellst Prototypen mit AI-Tools und hast die Freiheit, selbständig und schnell zu iterieren, um Ideen in Stunden zu testen statt in Wochen. Speed und Urteilsvermögen sind dein Kompass. „Shipped" bedeutet für dich: der Kunde nutzt es, und es liefert Wert. Woran wir Erfolg messen Du hast in den ersten 6 Monaten zu 2-3 vielversprechenden Product Bets durch echte Iteration mit Kundenfeedback beigetragen. Du bist in mindestens einem Kernbereich so tief drin, dass Engineers und Kunden dir vertrauen, wichtige Entscheidungen zu treffen. Was du mitbringst Du hast bereits digitale B2B-Produkte end-to-end entwickelt und erfolgreich iteriert. Du verstehst Kundenprobleme, denkst wirtschaftlich und hast nachweislich Mehrwert für Kunden und das Business geschaffen. Du gehst souverän mit Unsicherheit um. Du definierst Hypothesen, testest schnell, triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis unvollständiger Informationen und übernimmst Verantwortung, statt auf perfekte Anforderungen zu warten. AI ist fester Bestandteil deiner täglichen Arbeitsweise. Du nutzt LLMs, Agents und moderne AI-Tools wie Cursor oder Claude produktiv und hast bereits AI-Features oder AI-Workflows entwickelt – inklusive der typischen Herausforderungen wie Evals, Latenz, Halluzinationen oder Human-in-the-Loop. Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend. Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Design, Engineering und Go-to-Market zusammen und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln. Du willst zu Beginn bewusst als Individual Contributor tief ins Produkt eintauchen und Themen End-to-End selbst ownen. Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du glaubst daran, dass außergewöhnliche Produkte durch enge Zusammenarbeit entstehen. Deshalb bist du vier Tage pro Woche mit dem Team im Münchner Büro. Bonus Punkte Du hast selbst ein Unternehmen gegründet oder kommerzielle AI Lösungen gebaut. Erfahrung mit Immobilien-, ESG- oder Finanzdaten. Dealbreakers Du willst primär selbst Production-Code besitzen. Diese Rolle entscheidet, was gebaut wird und warum, und misst sich am Kundennutzen, nicht an gemergten PRs. Du brauchst klare Spezifikationen und abgestimmte Roadmaps, bevor du anfängst. Ambiguität verlangsamt dich, statt dich neugierig zu machen. AI-Tools sind für dich noch kein Teil deines täglichen Workflows, nicht als Lernbereitschaft, sondern als aktuelle Realität. Du arbeitest lieber im Stillen als im engen Austausch mit Kunden, CS und Product. Bei Predium gibt es keine Rolle, die hinter Prozessen verschwindet. Warum Predium? Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit. Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar, im Revenue und im Produkt. Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen. Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bo

jobs.description: We are looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to improve how we use data across marketing, sales, customer success, product, and billing. Your main responsibility is to understand how our revenue processes perform and why results change. You will define metrics, combine data from different systems, investigate patterns, and test assumptions. Your analyses should lead to measurable improvements. This may involve a better decision, a change to an existing process, or an automation that removes manual work and improves reliability. Reporting and dashboards are part of the role, but they are not the objective. Each analysis should answer a relevant business question and provide a clear basis for the next decision. You will also implement selected solutions, including data models, dashboards, and automations. Analysis remains the main focus. Implementation follows when the expected impact and method of measurement are clear. Previous professional experience is useful but not required. We value analytical judgement, accuracy, technical understanding, and the ability to learn. Tasks Analyse the customer journey from acquisition and conversion to retention and revenue. Define and maintain consistent metrics across marketing, sales, customer success, product, and finance. Extract, combine, clean, and validate data from operational and analytical systems. Investigate changes in customer behaviour, funnels, conversion rates, retention, costs, and revenue. Determine the likely causes of performance changes instead of only describing the result. Review existing reports and identify unreliable metrics, missing data, and conflicting definitions. Develop hypotheses and test them against the available data. Distinguish evidence from assumptions, correlations, and opinions. Estimate the expected impact of proposed changes and define how success will be measured. Prioritise opportunities based on impact, effort, and the reliability of the supporting data. Present findings and recommendations in a form that supports business decisions. Build selected dashboards, data models, automations, and process improvements. Measure implemented changes and assess whether they produced the expected result. Use AI assistants as a daily tool for research, data exploration, coding support, and documentation. Verify AI-generated results against the underlying data and original sources. Document metric definitions, data logic, assumptions, methods, and limitations. Requirements Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to solving problems. A high standard for data quality and reliable results. General programming knowledge and an interest in developing your technical skills. Initial experience with SQL, Python, JavaScript, APIs, spreadsheets, data warehouses, or business intelligence tools is beneficial. A basic understanding of statistics, including the difference between correlation and causation. The ability to examine a problem from different perspectives before reaching a conclusion. Interest in using AI assistants as part of analytical and technical work. The judgement to review AI-generated results critically. The ability to explain complex findings in clear language. The motivation to learn unfamiliar tools, systems, and business areas. The discipline to follow an analysis until the result is sufficiently reliable. At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

As a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d), you will be a part of the Commercial Intelligence Team within our Commercial Analytics unit. In this highly visible role, you will drive the development of analytical products and standards that enable data‑driven pricing, marketing, and revenue decisions across the organization. jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel (Product and Business Development)
jobs.location: Berlin, Germany; Limassol, Cyprus; Munich, Germany; Paphos, Cyprus; Prague, Czech Republic; Warsaw, Poland
jobs.description:
You understand that good legal counsel doesn’t just mitigate risk. It also fosters innovation. Comfortable navigating the gray areas of new technology, you enjoy finding pragmatic paths forward and building frameworks that help teams move faster.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

As we expand our AI initiatives and explore new commercial models, the legal landscape in which we operate is becoming more complex. We are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Product and Business Development legal team. This role isn't about saying "no"; it's about figuring out "how." You’ll shape scalable legal frameworks that support product innovation, strategic partnerships, and sustainable growth.

You’ll work closely with the Product, Go-to-Market, Business Development, Marketplace, and University Relations teams, helping them understand and navigate regulatory realities while keeping the focus on user value. You’ll own the legal life cycle of new offerings and partnerships, collaborating with a team of experienced lawyers to solve problems no one has solved before.

Day to day, you will:

  • Advise on the entire life cycle of software products, services, plugins, and AI features - from refining early concepts to retiring older features.
  • Implement legal and regulatory requirements, including AI regulation and consumer protection.
  • Draft, negotiate, and advise on strategic tech, AI partnership, and collaboration agreements.
  • Support JetBrains Marketplace initiatives and relationships with third-party platforms.
  • Guide the legal aspects of our educational, academic, and research initiatives.
  • Improve legal operations by designing templates, playbooks, and self-service resources that reduce the need for manual legal review.
  • Equip the sales and procurement legal teams with product expertise to help them negotiate customer and vendor agreements.
  • Share knowledge and insights across the legal team and broader business to build awareness around best practices.

What you’ll bring

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving, balancing legal risk with business realities.
  • The ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly and simply to non-lawyers.
  • A strong ownership mentality, seeing matters through from start to finish.
  • Comfort making decisions in ambiguous environments, especially regarding novel technologies like AI.
  • A collaborative mindset, working well with stakeholders across different teams and disciplines.
  • A continuous drive to improve workflows, automating or standardizing routine tasks where possible.
  • Transparency, integrity, and the willingness to speak up when something doesn’t make sense.

What you’ll need

  • A formal degree in law (LLB, LLM, Mgr, or equivalent).
  • An extensive background advising multinational corporations on technology and commercial law.
  • A proven track record of successfully drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial and technology agreements.
  • A deep understanding of software products, digital services, and technology business models.
  • Fluency in English and the ability to negotiate and draft complex legal documents clearly and effectively.
  • The demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex tasks and stakeholder relationships simultaneously.

What success looks like

Success means you’ll have become a trusted advisor to our product and business teams. You don’t just review contracts. You are actively involved in the strategy, ensuring legal frameworks are an enabler of growth rather than a bottleneck. Over time, you will have established clear, scalable self-service resources that allow teams to handle routine legal questions independently, freeing you up to focus on high-impact, complex challenges. You’ll leave things cleaner and more efficient than you found them.

Why join JetBrains? 

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
  • Learning and development opportunitie

Through our unique incubation platform, seed financing, and exceptional teams of visionary entrepreneurs and engineers, we transfer world-leading research into products that will change existing and create new industries. Merantix currently employs more than 200 team members. Its growing platform constitutes a unique brand with a shared tech and operational infrastructure that attracts talent, resonates with industry partners, and leverages the proven network and product-building experience. Your role We are growing our AI investment team and are looking for a visiting analyst to join our Merantix investment team for 6 months starting in September 2026. With our current fund , we're advancing beyond our legacy incubation model to co-invest in early-stage AI-driven ventures. We leverage the breadth of our Merantix Platform to provide a strong foundation for the growth of these emerging technologies. If that resonates with you, here is what your role at Merantix includes: Research, identify emerging AI startups and connect with their founders. Conduct initial evaluation and in-depth analysis of new investment opportunities. Support our due diligence processes and day-to-day operations. Assist our Entrepreneurs-in-Residence on business case evaluation of new AI ventures. Creation of communication and presentation material for meetings with partners and investors. We are looking for driven, capable, visionary, and prudent talents with a strong emphasis on technology and a proven track record of personal, academic, and professional achievement. You have an undergraduate degree from a top-­tier university, MA/MSc/MBA is a plus; You have a long-­held interest in technology, both personally and professionally; A technical degree in fields such as computer science, mathematics, or engineering, or significant exposure to emerging technologies and AI through professional work, is a plus; You have gained professional experience in an impactful entrepreneurial environment, at a leading technology company, or in management consultancy/ venture capital; Superb English communication skills, both verbal and written, and interpersonal skills and an ability to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams; You have strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to prioritize appropriately and effectively; You are available to work with us for 6 months at a time. jobs.title: Lead AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Zum Hauptinhalt springen Deutsch Deutsch Zurück zu allen Stellen Lead AI Product Manager (f/m/d) Munich Vollzeit Festanstellung Auf diese Stelle bewerben Unsere Opportunity Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche. Deine Mission Du verantwortest das Produkt auf beiden Ebenen: das bestehende ESG-Produkt weiterentwickeln und die nächste Evolutionsstufe mitgestalten, den AI-Analysten für Asset Manager, Credit Officers und Transaction Manager. Du berichtest direkt an unser Gründer-/Führungsteam und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kunden und internen Teams zusammen. Du bist verantwortlich für Kundennutzen und Umsatz, nicht für Features. Du gehst zum Kunden mit, verstehst ihre Welt, und übersetzt das in validierte Prototypen und klare Build-Entscheidungen. Was du konkret tust Own strategic product development: Du gehst raus zu unseren Kunden, verstehst ihre Prozesse sowie pain points, die sie selbst ohne dein Zutun nicht erwähnen. Du baust eigenverantwortlich Produkte, die die Nachhaltigkeit von Immobilien fördern und einen messbaren finanziellen Impact auf unsere Kunden und unser Produkt haben. Collaborate closely: Du arbeitest mit direkter Reporting-Linie zu Gründer-/ Führungsteam sowie einem starken Engineering-Team zusammen und erhältst jegliche Unterstützung, um die richtigen Produkte schnell an den Kunden zu bringen. Iterate fast, finish fully: Du erstellst Prototypen mit AI-Tools und hast die Freiheit, selbständig und schnell zu iterieren, um Ideen in Stunden zu testen statt in Wochen. Speed und Urteilsvermögen sind dein Kompass. „Shipped" bedeutet für dich: der Kunde nutzt es, und es liefert Wert. Woran wir Erfolg messen Du hast in den ersten 6 Monaten zu 2-3 vielversprechenden Product Bets durch echte Iteration mit Kundenfeedback beigetragen. Du bist in mindestens einem Kernbereich so tief drin, dass Engineers und Kunden dir vertrauen, wichtige Entscheidungen zu treffen. Was du mitbringst Du hast bereits digitale B2B-Produkte end-to-end entwickelt und erfolgreich iteriert. Du verstehst Kundenprobleme, denkst wirtschaftlich und hast nachweislich Mehrwert für Kunden und das Business geschaffen. Du gehst souverän mit Unsicherheit um. Du definierst Hypothesen, testest schnell, triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis unvollständiger Informationen und übernimmst Verantwortung, statt auf perfekte Anforderungen zu warten. AI ist fester Bestandteil deiner täglichen Arbeitsweise. Du nutzt LLMs, Agents und moderne AI-Tools wie Cursor oder Claude produktiv und hast bereits AI-Features oder AI-Workflows entwickelt – inklusive der typischen Herausforderungen wie Evals, Latenz, Halluzinationen oder Human-in-the-Loop. Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend. Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Design, Engineering und Go-to-Market zusammen und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln. Du willst zu Beginn bewusst als Individual Contributor tief ins Produkt eintauchen und Themen End-to-End selbst ownen. Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du glaubst daran, dass außergewöhnliche Produkte durch enge Zusammenarbeit entstehen. Deshalb bist du vier Tage pro Woche mit dem Team im Münchner Büro. Bonus Punkte Du hast selbst ein Unternehmen gegründet oder kommerzielle AI Lösungen gebaut. Erfahrung mit Immobilien-, ESG- oder Finanzdaten. Dealbreakers Du willst primär selbst Production-Code besitzen. Diese Rolle entscheidet, was gebaut wird und warum, und misst sich am Kundennutzen, nicht an gemergten PRs. Du brauchst klare Spezifikationen und abgestimmte Roadmaps, bevor du anfängst. Ambiguität verlangsamt dich, statt dich neugierig zu machen. AI-Tools sind für dich noch kein Teil deines täglichen Workflows, nicht als Lernbereitschaft, sondern als aktuelle Realität. Du arbeitest lieber im Stillen als im engen Austausch mit Kunden, CS und Product. Bei Predium gibt es keine Rolle, die hinter Prozessen verschwindet. Warum Predium? Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit. Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar, im Revenue und im Produkt. Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen. Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust. Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 4 Tage/Woche. 30 Urlaubstage (inkl. Betriebsurlaub) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · Team-Events Über uns Bei Predium fokussieren wir uns darauf, den Wert von Immobilien nachhaltig zu steigern. Wir entwickeln eine Plattform für nachhaltiges und profitables Immobilienmanagement, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, sowohl ihre Klimaziele als auch ihre finanziellen Ziele zu erreichen. jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (Fullstack)
jobs.location: Europe, UK, Germany, France, European timezones
jobs.description: About Clipster Clipster is where brands and creators connect to turn views into profits. Clippers (Creators) clip, remix, and post branded content on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X, and beyond — earning money for every view they deliver. Brands get a significantly better influencer marketing experience thanks to scale, simplicity, and reliable performance tracking. We started as an influencer marketing agency. While clients loved our results, delivering them was a pain. So we started automating everything we did — and it paid off. 2025 was a great year for us: We launched our platform in early 2025 We grew our team to 35 members We scaled from 0 to more than 100,000 creators and paid out more than $5M to them We acquired more than 120 clients solely through word of mouth. Our growth has been 100% organic We ran campaigns for companies such as Telegram, UFC, Universal Music Group and artists such as Elton John, Ed Sheeran, Playboi Carti, and Kendrick Lamar We're profitable and have secured our first investor The role We are looking for a Backend-Heavy Senior Engineer who isn't afraid to touch the full stack. While your primary domain will be our Golang services and distributed architecture, you are a "Product Engineer" at heart — meaning you understand the "why" behind the code and can jump into the React/Next.js frontend whenever it's the shortest path to delivering value. The mindset we hire for Intensity & Grit — You run toward hard problems and stay until they are solved. Ambitious Simplification — You have the intelligence to solve complex problems and the wisdom to choose the simplest solution. Ownership & Mission Alignment — You don't "close tickets"; you ship outcomes. You care about the creator economy as much as we do. AI Readiness — You leverage modern tools to multiply your output and keep us at the cutting edge. Humility & Collaboration — You are a high-bandwidth communicator who mentors others and leaves your ego at the door. Your technical toolkit Core Backend — 5+ years of experience, with at least 3+ years of mastery in Golang. Comfortable with high-performance distributed systems. Fullstack Versatility — Backend is your home, but you have the skills to navigate and contribute to a React/Next.js frontend. Infrastructure & Data — Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and ideally GCP. Architectural Mindset — You move seamlessly from system design to shipping production-ready code. Clean code, test coverage, and documentation are your tools for maintaining velocity. Bonus points Experience with payment systems (we handle around $1M in monthly payouts). Event-driven architectures and real-time data processing. Why Clipster Total ownership - Join a lean tech team of fewer than 15 people. What you build today, millions will use tomorrow. Remote & async - Work where you are most effective. We only ask for availability during our core hours (10am – 2pm UTC+2). Zero bureaucracy - No endless meetings. We value documentation, Slack, and Loom for high-bandwidth, low-noise collaboration. Next steps Discovery call - a brief chat with our recruiter. Pair programming - a hands-on session with one of our engineers. System design - a discussion about an architectural problem, based on our day-to-day problems. Engineering excellence discussion. Final meet - chat with our Founder and PM to talk mission and values.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Product (Belo Horizonte)
jobs.description: This is a remote role for candidates located in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $100M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services — operating across three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome) on a single shared platform. About Engineering at LawnStarter We build in small, focused initiative teams: a Product Engineer working alongside a PM and a designer, supported by an Engineering Manager who helps you grow. You'll also work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering peers across initiatives in a shared codebase. The whole team owns whether the work moves its metric. AI coding agents are a force multiplier here — they give a small, senior team the leverage to ship more, faster, and at a higher bar for quality. We hire engineers who are wired for ownership and energized by shipping to a real marketplace with customers and pros on both sides. The Role You're the engineering anchor of an initiative — working as part of a tight team with your PM and designer, and alongside engineering peers on adjacent initiatives. You have a hand in the full lifecycle: shaping the problem, deciding the technical approach, directing AI agents to implement much of the code, shipping to production, and — with your team — owning the outcome. You're measured by impact, not by lines of code merged. When an agent can ship something safely, your job is to make sure it's done right and the metric moves. When the work calls for careful, hand-written code in a sensitive area, you write it yourself. What makes this role exciting: You ship end-to-end. From problem-framing through production to the post-launch metric review — you see the whole arc and own the result with your team. You work as a true product partner. You sit at the table with PM and design, bringing engineering judgment to product calls and product sense to engineering calls. You get real autonomy — with the right checkpoints. You make most technical calls yourself, with architect review on significant architectural decisions and fast input from peers. You operate at a staff bar. You're trusted to make the call, ship the hard thing, and stand behind the outcome. What You'll Own The technical approach — architecture, data model, integration choices, rollout plan, observability, and rollback strategy for your initiative. You make most calls yourself and bring significant architectural decisions to architect review; you document them, and revisit if the data says you were wrong. Implementation quality — the prompts, guardrails, evals, tests, and review loop that let agents ship safe, correct, production-ready code. Most lines will be agent-authored, and you're accountable for them — held to the same standard as the rest of the team working in a shared codebase. Cross-functional partnership — daily working contact with your PM (scope, tradeoffs) and designer (UX decisions, in-tool prototyping), regular collaboration with engineering peers, and weekly check-ins with your EM. The initiative outcome — the metric the initiative was set up to move. With your PM, you present results 2–4 weeks post-launch and share the "did it work" answer. A high bar for what ships — production correctness, security, performance, observability, and the experience for customers and pros. Agents accelerate you; they don't lower the bar. Problems to Solve Leading AI agents at a staff-level quality bar Most of the code on your initiative will be authored by AI agents. The craft is making them ship as if a senior engineer wrote it: prompts that encode our conventions, evals that catch issues before merge, tests that exercise the edges, observability that catches a regression before a customer does. How do you build a workflow that lets a small team ship far more than its size would suggest? Owning decisions with high autonomy You have real latitude to make and document technical calls quickly — with architect review on the big architectural ones and peers to pressure-test your thinking. How do you move fast, keep your team aligned, and stay accountable to the outcome? Shipping outcomes, not features Each initiative is measured by a metric — a conversion rate, a retention curve, a pro-funnel KPI, a unit-economics shift. You're accountable for the number alongside your team. How do you scope to actually move it, decide what *not* to build, and have the discipline to follow up 2–4 weeks after launch? What Success Looks Like (Year 1) Initiative outcomes hit — You've shipped 3–4 initiatives end-to-end, and at least two clearly moved their metric (with the post-launch review to prove it). Agent workflow that travels — The prompts, evals, and review loop you built are picked up by peers on other initiatives. Faster cycle time — Median time from problem-framing to first production rollout on your initiatives is meaningfully shorter. Quality

jobs.title: Product Manager - Decision Intelligence & Experimentation
jobs.description:
When travelers are searching for a hotel, we want the obvious choice to be trivago! Our leading metasearch engine is super fast and constantly optimized - enabling millions of travelers to compare hotel prices from hundreds of booking sites and find great deals in just a few clicks. We use cutting-edge technology, real-time auction, and machine learning techniques with petabytes of data to create an experience - time and money saved! In the lively city of Düsseldorf, we seize opportunities to learn everyday, innovate, and make an enduring mark on the travel industry. At trivago you will find those who aren't afraid of change but rather embrace it, turning every challenge into a pathway for growth. Join trivago, work with a great team, and grow with us!

 

Join us in making a difference

At trivago, every product decision is validated through data, every improvement is shipped through an experiment, and every insight should be instantly accessible to everyone who needs it. As Senior Product Manager for Decision Intelligence & Experimentation, you will own the platform that makes all of that possible — trivago's A/B testing infrastructure and analytics intelligence layer, embedded at the heart of Hotel Search.

In this role, you are shaping the platform that every product manager, data scientist, and business owner at trivago depends on to do their best work. You will own the roadmap, drive adoption across the organization, and lead trivago's transformation toward an AI-augmented analytics function — with executive sponsorship and company-wide scope. trivago's caring performance culture means you will be genuinely supported to grow and challenged to lead. If you want to own the platform that makes everyone else better at their job, this is your moment. Apply now.

 

How you'll make an impact

  • Own the product roadmap for trivago's A/B testing infrastructure across web, mobile web, and app — turning experimentation into a company-wide, self-serve capability.
  • Raise the bar on experiment quality: build the systems that turn individual tests into compounding organizational learning through metadata, cross-experiment insights, and searchable learnings libraries.
  • Define the product vision for trivago's analytics intelligence layer — moving beyond static dashboards toward AI-assisted insight generation and proactive decision support.
  • Lead the analytics AI transformation agenda: agent-assisted data querying, intelligent anomaly detection, automated narrative generation, and intelligent signals embedded in how teams work.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Data Science to build a governed, trustworthy data foundation that business teams can access autonomously.
  • Develop training programs and adoption playbooks to raise experimentation literacy and data fluency across the organization.
  • Create and drive the vision and roadmap for the product, align stakeholders, and facilitate product outcomes discussions with the team and senior leadership.

 

What you'll need to thrive

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years owning A/B testing, experimentation platforms, or analytics infrastructure in consumer-facing digital products.
  • Solid grasp of statistical foundations: significance testing, power analysis, experimental design, and causal inference

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description: Product Jobs / Lead Product Manager Posted 5 days ago Oyster HR Lead Product Manager 5 day week 40 days PTO Remote · Romania +6 more Job Description About Oyster HR ✨ One platform, a whole world of opportunity The best jobs are often restricted to a few wealthy cities, but talent exists everywhere. Oyster set out to change this by launching a global employment platform that enables companies to hire, pay, and support talent anywhere. We're proof that a strong, engaged culture doesn't require an office. Since January 2020, Oyster has: 🌏 Built a distributed team of 500+ across 60+ countries 👩‍💻 Featured in Forbes as #9 in FlexJobs Top 30 Companies for remote jobs 🌈 Formed a diverse leadership team and a workforce that's 60% female 🏆 Earned top employee engagement scores 🦄 Raised $286 million; valued at $1.2 billion 💚 Achieved B Corp status in 2023 Our momentum shows the power of global employment, and we're just getting started! If you want to help us drive change and work remotely, we'd love for you to apply! One Opportunity, Two Product Domains Location: While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster's positions are fully remote, you can work from home, forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be based within UTC +3 to UTC -5 . We're hiring two Lead Product Managers with the same scope, level, and expectations, supporting two different product domains: Hire & Onboard and Benefits . By applying to this role, you'll be considered for either opportunity. Throughout the interview process, we'll introduce you to both domains, discuss where your experience and interests align best, and determine together which role is the strongest mutual fit. As a Lead Product Manager , you will own the product vision, strategy, and execution for a critical area of Oyster's platform. Whether focused on Hire & Onboard or Benefits , you'll lead customer-facing experiences, internal tools, and operational workflows that help companies employ talent globally with confidence, compliance, and simplicity. You are an AI-first product thinker, comfortable applying automation and AI to solve meaningful customer and operational challenges. You bring strong product judgment, a structured approach to problem-solving, and the ability to balance user needs, regulatory complexity, and business outcomes. In this role, you'll operate at the intersection of product strategy, execution, and cross-functional leadership. You'll drive complex initiatives in partnership with Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Go-to-Market teams. Strong ownership, clear communication, and the ability to build alignment across diverse stakeholders are essential to success. Key Responsibilities Own the product vision and strategy for either the Hire & Onboard or Benefits domain, aligned with company goals and customer outcomes. Lead discovery and prioritisation across hiring and onboarding problems, balancing new features, regulatory needs, tech debt, and operational improvements. Translate strategy into execution , defining clear roadmaps, outcomes, and success metrics. Partner closely with Engineering and Design to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions with strong user experience. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including Operations, Legal/Compliance and Go-to-Market to ensure feasibility and alignment. Represent the Hire & Onboard or Benefits domain in senior stakeholder forums, clearly communicating trade-offs, progress, risks, and impact. Identify and evaluate opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve hiring and onboarding outcomes, efficiency, and decision-making. Use data and insights (quantitative and qualitative) to inform decisions, measure impact, and continuously improve outcomes. Ensure regulatory and compliance requirements are embedded into product development without compromising usability or speed. Continuously improve product processes , contributing to best practices across the wider Product organisation. Core Requirements 5+ years of experience in Product Management , with a strong track record of owning complex product areas end-to-end and driving measurable business and customer outcomes. 3+ years of experience in HR tech, hiring, onboarding, benefits, payroll, compliance, or B2B SaaS , with a solid understanding of regulated or operationally complex domains. Strong product discovery and problem-framing skills , with the ability to deeply understand customer pain points, validate assumptions, and translate insights into impactful product solutions. You have a demonstrable capability for original thinking, and have great examples of how you have understood and solved a problem from first principles. You are a builder, and can demonstrate you have actively worked with AI-prototyping tools and used them to gain valuable feedback from users Hands-on experience building or iterating on AI-powered and automation-driven features , incl

jobs.title: Staff AI Product Analyst, Product Management
jobs.description: Product Jobs / Staff AI Product Analyst, Product Management Posted 6 days ago Grafana Labs Staff AI Product Analyst, Product Management 5 day week 30 days PTO Remote · USA Job Description About Grafana Labs Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the the USA on Eastern time zones. About the Role We’re looking for a Staff Product Analyst to join our growing Product Analytics team and serve as a strategic partner to Grafana’s AI organization . This role will support the teams building Grafana Assistant , our synchronous chat experience; Investigations , our asynchronous AI workflow for incident analysis; and AI observability solutions , including Sigil . You will shape how the AI team measures success by defining KPIs, improving measurement practices, guiding experiment design and evaluation, and translating data into recommendations that influence product decisions. This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data partners, with a primary focus on supporting the AI team, and report to the Product Analytics Manager If you’re excited about building strong product analytics capabilities and using data to shape the future of AI-powered experiences at Grafana , we’d love to hear from you. You Will Partner cross functionally across Product to establish top-level KPIs, dashboards, and product roadmap planning Define how success is measured for AI-powered product experiences, including adoption, engagement, quality, retention, and user outcomes Guide the instrumentation of product data in collaboration with our Product Design, Product Management, and Engineering teams to enable reliable analysis of AI features and workflows. Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments to assess the impact of new AI capabilities and inform product decisions. Develop dbt models to transform and test our user behavior data in partnership with our Analytics Engineering team Influence best practices for Product Analytics across teams and help define standards as the company scales Contribute to defining the long-term vision and strategy for Product Analytics, balancing near-term needs with scalable, durable solutions. You have Experience partnering across product and engineering organizations, and familiarity with typical product KPIs and frameworks (e.g., DAU/MAU, funnels, A/B testing) Experience defining and tracking success metrics for complex product areas, ideally including AI-powered features or workflows. SQL: writing complex yet efficient SQL is a daily habit for you Data Visualization: experience with any of the following tools: Tableau, Looker, Omni, Hex, or of course, Grafana! Experience writing dbt models, implementing Product Analytics tooling (e.g., Heap, Pendo, Amplitude, FullStory), and code version control (git) Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to quickly prototype and iterate across analysis, data modeling, instrumentation, visualization and code development. Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences, and maintain many of the essential cross-team and cross-functional relationships necessary for the team’s success A plus if you have Knowledge about observability Familiarity with Airflow or Prefect - generating ad hoc ETL jobs In the USA, the Base compensation range for this role is $162,275 - $194,730 USD.  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits

PMs write the changelog posts and PMM approves them. Team Lead, Product Operations (Abóboda Factory)

Liderar e coordenar as operações diárias da equipa de Product Operations, garantindo a eficiência dos processos, a correta alocação de recursos e a execução das prioridades definidas.   • 🌟 A flexible working model - We want our employees to do their best work, wherever and however it works best for them.
  • 🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  • 📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  • 🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - House Owner & Service Request Acquisition (all genders)
jobs.description: Responsibilities We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and grow the top of our marketplace funnel. Aroundhome is a two-sided marketplace platform where the possibility of shared success begins with the match: the moment a homeowner is connected with the right partner. The House Owner & Service Request Acquisition domain owns everything upstream of that match. It starts when a homeowner discovers Aroundhome through search or content, continues as they describe their home project, and ends when a qualified service request is handed to matching. The quality of that request shapes the experience on both sides of the marketplace, so acquisition volume, conversion, and data quality are all part of your responsibility. At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping the success of Germany's leading housing project platform. We work in a domain-based model, where each product team owns a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration within cross-functional teams and ensures that the expertise for continuous product discovery, hypothesis development, and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. As a Senior Product Manager, you drive and execute the strategy, set a clear direction, and make sure your domain delivers meaningful value to both customer groups, homeowners and partners, as well as to the business. You continuously shape domain strategy and vision, setting clear measurable goals and a roadmap for homeowner acquisition: steering the full acquisition mix across paid and unpaid channels with a clear focus on growing the organic share, improving conversion along the homeowner journey, and raising the quality of the service requests handed to matching. You actively rally those around you toward this vision. You grow sustainable, unpaid acquisition through SEO, AI search optimization and scalable acquisition systems that compound over time, while keeping paid channels an effective and efficient part of the mix. You design and read high-traffic conversion experiments to lift conversion and data quality. You are responsible for building a robust architecture and foundation that supports our acquisition experience. You ensure our setup is scalable and ready for automated qualification, enabling seamless processes that benefit the entire marketplace. You identify where AI genuinely improves the homeowner experience and the platform's qualification processes, and you bring those opportunities into production together with Engineering, from first prompt experiments to shipped, measurable features. You drive domain growth through continuous end-to-end product discovery, using qualitative insights (interviews, usability tests, feedback, NPS) and quantitative data to identify opportunities and make evidence-based, outcome-driven decisions with measurable impact. You communicate with clarity and purpose, translate complex system and data topics into compelling narratives, and foster strong collaboration across Product, Tech, Product Analytics, UX, SEO and Content, Sales, and cross-domain stakeholders. You help carry the shift from a sales-driven organization toward a product platform. You ensure a strong balance between long-term strategic goals and short-term trade-offs, driving continuous lean delivery through effective backlog management and close collaboration with Engineering and Design. Skills You have hands-on experience building organic acquisition and understand SEO fundamentals (topical authority, local SEO, structured data, page performance) as well as how AI-driven search and assistants are changing discovery (AEO), ideally within a marketplace or high-volume consumer platform. You are experienced in optimizing complex user funnels and conversion flows, using experimentation (A/B testing) and data to improve conversion, quality, and user trust while laying the foundation for long-term platform engagement. You apply strong analytical thinking and product analytics skills to define success measures, interpret data, uncover insights, and guide evidence-based decisions that improve homeowner and business outcomes. You bring a strong technical affinity to help shape our underlying acquisition and conversion architecture. You understand the concepts of data models or taxonomies and have enough grasp of APIs and data flows to reason about feasibility and sequencing with engineers. You work with LLMs as a natural part of your daily practice and can show concretely how they strengthen your discovery, analysis, and delivery. Ideally, you have taken AI beyond personal productivity and understand how scalable AI solutions reach production-grade features, for example through prompt chains, LLM-supported data extraction, or automated qualification flows. jobs.title: Associate Product Manager, Delivery (m/f/d)
jobs.description: We are looking for a Associate Product Delivery Manager to help turn product priorities into clear, well-organized work for our engineering and design teams. Working closely with our Product Lead, you will help define new features, prepare upcoming work, coordinate requirements, and keep track of sprint progress. You will bring structure and clarity to the product-development process while growing your product-management skills through hands-on experience and mentorship. This is a good opportunity for someone early in their product career who is organized, curious, and comfortable collaborating across different disciplines. Tasks Draft feature scopes, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the Product Lead. Help maintain and organize the product backlog. Prepare features and tasks for refinement and sprint planning. Coordinate requirements and open questions between product, engineering, and design. Track sprint status, delivery progress, dependencies, and blockers. Keep the team and relevant stakeholders informed about progress and changes. Support planning, refinement, reviews, and other product-delivery meetings. Document product requirements, decisions, and changes. Gather the information needed for prioritization discussions. Contribute recommendations while the Product Lead retains final prioritization responsibility. Help improve the team’s product-development and delivery processes. Take on greater product ownership as your skills and experience develop. Requirements What we’re looking for Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in product management, project coordination, business analysis, software delivery, design, QA, or a related area. Relevant internships and working-student experience may count. Some experience working with software engineering, design, or other multidisciplinary teams. The ability to turn discussions and ideas into clear written requirements and action items. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Clear and thoughtful written and verbal communication. Confidence following up on open questions, dependencies, and commitments. Curiosity about users, technology, and how digital products are built. A collaborative mindset and willingness to ask questions and learn. Basic familiarity with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Linear, Notion, or Confluence. Helpful, but not required Experience writing user stories or acceptance criteria. Familiarity with sprint planning, backlog refinement, or software-release processes. Enough technical curiosity to learn about APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation trade-offs. Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or another quickly changing environment. You do not need to meet every item on this list. We care about your potential, judgment, communication skills, and willingness to learn. What success looks like within your first six months: Upcoming features and tasks are documented clearly and prepared on time. Sprint progress, dependencies, and blockers are visible to the team. Product decisions and requirement changes are consistently documented. Engineering and design know where to find the information they need. Open questions are identified and brought to the right people early. The Product Lead has reliable support across planning, prioritization, and delivery. You begin handling smaller features with increasing independence. Benefits We offer an exciting environment at the interface between IT and entertainment and marketing as part of an ambitious, international and results-orientated team in a young startup. You work with an excellent international team with varied tasks with a wide range of great opportunities An attractive and competitive salary Monthly learning budget Urban Sports Club membership support Support for your favourite means of transport - we help finance your new bike or your public transport subscription We are a startup in one of the cultural hubs in Berlin, you'll never get bored We welcome applicants with different backgrounds and experiences. jobs.description:
MongoDB’s Developer Productivity organization exists to help engineers build and deliver high-quality software through a highly effective software development process and a strong foundation of shared tools and services.

We are looking for a Senior Director to lead our Pipeline team. This role is tasked with bringing together the major systems and experiences that power software delivery at MongoDB. The team’s mission is to provide a reliable, scalable, secure, and effective platform for ensuring fast software deployability, leveraging AI native approaches.

We are open to in-office, flexible or remote hiring across Canada.

The Team

The Pipeline organization sits within Developer Productivity and is responsible for the systems, services, and user experiences that define MongoDB’s software delivery ecosystem.   This is mission-critical infrastructure operating at substantial scale and supports a variety of software product delivery needs. Success in this role requires excellent product judgment for developer-facing experiences, strong systems and platform leadership, and the ability to align multiple teams around a cohesive strategy.

Candidate Profile

We’re looking for a senior engineering leader who can unify product-minded developer tooling with deep platform and operational excellence. The right candidate is passionate about developer productivity and has a track record of leading managers and teams through organizational growth, technical complexity, and cross-functional change.

They should be comfortable owning a broad portfolio that spans developer experience, reliability and scale, release systems, telemetry, and operational health. They should also be able to work effectively with senior leaders and partners across engineering and product to set direction, allocate resources, and make trade-offs that balance near-term delivery with long-term platform function.

The right candidate for this role will

  • 12+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and operating production systems; experience in developer tooling, platform engineering, observability, or data engineering is a strong plus.

  • Have experience with cloud infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code principles; experience with Kubernetes and AWS is especially valuable.

  • Have experience or strong familiarity with software supply chain and release concerns, including reliability, security, and operational rigor.
  • Be able to define strategy and drive execution in ambiguous environments with broad organizational impact, acting as a trusted escalation point for complex technical and organizational trade-offs.

What you will do

  • Set portfolio priorities and resource allocation in partnership with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, balancing urgent delivery needs with long-term platform investments.
  • Improve the experience of internal engineering users while also raising the bar on reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Developer Productivity

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who is ready to lead through ambiguity and improve how software gets built at MongoDB. This role leads teams focused on developer productivity, with an emphasis on measurable improvements to the software development lifecycle.

This role can be based remotely in Canada.

The Team

The AXIS team (AI, X-functional tools, Insights, and Signals) sits within Developer Productivity and is responsible for overseeing the metrics and observability infrastructure of our expansive developer environment to help build a strong data-driven culture.  You’ll also be a key partner in building the agentic ecosystem for AI-driven development across engineering.

Candidate Profile

We’re looking for an experienced leader with a passion for solving the big challenge of measuring developer productivity and providing the actionable signals that help teams improve their performance. They should be comfortable working collaboratively with other leaders and partners across our Engineering and Data teams in maximizing the use of data for insights and AI enablement. 

The right candidate for this role will have

  • 4+ years of experience managing software engineers, including hiring, performance management, growth planning, and compensation; required for external candidates and preferred for internal candidates
  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and operating production systems; experience in developer tooling, platform engineering, observability, or data engineering is a strong plus
  • Demonstrated the ability to lead through ambiguity, work across team boundaries, and deliver outcomes without close supervision
  • Strong customer orientation and sound judgment in finding practical, high-leverage solutions
  • Experience working with systems involving analytics, data pipelines, and metrics platforms
  • Experience with AI tools development and enablement efforts
  • Strong technical judgment, including the ability to evaluate tradeoffs, identify risks, and ask the right questions without needing to be hands-on in the code every day
  • Ability to connect observability, engineering metrics, and AI capabilities to meaningful improvements in the developer ecosystem
  • Excellent communication skills with engineers, peer managers, and senior leadership
  • A track record of building inclusive, high-performing teams where engineers can do their best work

Position Expectations

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to a team of engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Improve engineering visibility and decision-making. Ensure your team delivers the systems, analytics, and reporting needed for Engineering leadership to understand the health, performance, and efficiency of the software development lifecycle
  • Evaluate, integrate, and build AI-enabled interfaces and tools that drive engineer productivity improvements, with a focus on measurable impact and responsible rollout
  • Drive the roadmap. Partner with Staff and Senior Staff ICs, TPMs, and stakeholders to define and evolve a 12-month roadmap that balances near-term delivery with long-term platform investment

Success Measures

  • In the first month, understand the team structure, active projects, and stakeholder landscape. Build trust with your direct reports and identify the top execution risks
  • In three months, deliver meaningful improvements in at least one area, measured through adoption, reliability, or developer satisfaction, and establish yourself as a reliable partner to peers and leadership
  • In twelve months, complete a full performance and growth cycle for your team, define a coherent multi-domain strategy, and drive measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness and developer experience across MongoDB

 

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

You’ll build reusable data models, optimize data infrastructure, and champion automation and AI-powered workflows to unlock real-time business insights. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, have advanced analytics engineering skills, and enjoy partnering with business leaders to drive strategic analysis, this is the role for you. Apply now! YOUR ROLE AT SIXT You support the business by designing and maintaining logical data architecture, including star schemas, cubes, and dimension tables You manage the technical execution of Redshift migration, optimizing table structures and query performance for efficient analytics You liaise with cross-functional teams to build reusable data models and ensure consistent KPI definitions You maintain data quality and integrity across key business datasets, establishing testing, documentation, and governance standards You receive and automate manual data processes by building pipelines and leveraging AI-powered coding assistants You assist with deep-dive analyses, translating business questions into analytical frameworks and synthesizing data into actionable recommendations for senior management YOUR SKILLS MATTER Experience You have 2-5 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity Education You have a bachelor’s degree in Math, Business, Data Analytics/Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, and are authorized to work in Portugal Technical Proficiency You possess SQL skills, experience with cloud data platforms (Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake), and familiarity with BI/visualization tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) Soft Skills You demonstrate strong communication skills, business literacy, and the ability to present complex data architecture decisions in English Commitment to Excellence You are automation-minded, AI-fluent, and able to manage your own priorities with a self-directed approach Additional Skills You are familiar with data modeling concepts, prompt engineering WHAT WE OFFER A Global Tech Hub in Lisbon Join a thriving international tech community and work alongside engineers, product experts, and business teams who turn ideas into real impact. Our hubs at Factory Lisboa in Beato and ARTs Lisboa in Parque das Nações are where great tech gets built Learning & Knowledge Exchange Level up through regular events with internal and external speakers. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and open exchange – across teams, disciplines, and borders Flexible Work Setup Two office days a week, flexible hours, and modern spaces built for both deep focus and team collaboration – work the way that brings out your best Time Off & Wellbeing Enjoy 28 vacation days per year, an additional day off on your birthday, one volunteer day annually, and private health insurance that also covers your spouse and children free of charge Practical Everyday Benefits Get a yearly Coverflex allowance and a daily meal allowance to make everyday life a little easier SIXT Perks Get exclusive rates on all SIXT services, with special discounts extended to your family and friends. Because great perks are even better when you can share them About us: We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.00 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 350,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 110 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

jobs.description: Product Jobs / Product Manager - Quality Posted 5 days ago Parsons Corporation Product Manager - Quality 9 day fortnight Remote · USA Job Description About Parsons Corporation In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description: Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Product Manager / Quality Lead to join our team! In this role you will get to support the iNET product team under Digital Labs, leading our Quality team . What You'll Be Doing: Lead and manage the Product Quality function, establishing quality standards, processes, and best practices across the product portfolio. Own the end-to-end product quality strategy, ensuring products meet defined functional, performance, usability, and reliability requirements. Create, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test strategies, test cases, and test scripts for new features, enhancements, and product releases. Define quality acceptance criteria and partner with Product, Engineering, and Design teams to ensure requirements are testable and measurable. Establish and track key quality metrics, including defect trends, test coverage, release readiness, customer-reported issues, and overall product health. Collaborate with Automation Engineers and Software Development teams to design, prioritize, and implement automated testing solutions that improve efficiency and coverage. Identify opportunities to expand test automation and reduce manual testing efforts while maintaining high quality standards. Review automated test results, analyze failures, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions. Develop and oversee regression testing, integration testing, end-to-end testing, and user acceptance testing processes. Coordinate testing activities across multiple product teams to ensure consistent execution and release quality. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight guests. They deeply understand user needs and translate these into strategies that combine strong product thinking with deep research. They partner with talented cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Analytics, Data Science, Finance, and Payments, leading teams to execute a shared vision. Critically, they work alongside platform product teams who build the underlying capabilities — knowing when to own, when to collaborate, and when to hand off. You will be joining the Wallet team, working closely with Payments, Design, Engineering, Finance, Analytics, Trust & Safety, and our broader Guest Experience organization to build the financial home for every Airbnb guest. The Difference You Will Make We are seeking an exceptional product marketing leader to define and build Wallet — Airbnb's new financial hub for guests. Wallet will transform how guests manage their financial relationship with Airbnb, bringing together payment methods, stored value, credits, and spending features into one trusted, engaging place that guests return to between trips — not just at checkout. You will drive the product vision and roadmap for Wallet end-to-end: from the core financial hub experience through to its integration with Payments and Checkout. The ideal candidate brings deep experience building consumer financial products, understands the payments ecosystem, and has the checkout and conversion instincts to reduce friction at the moment of booking. Success in this role means guests proactively managing their financial relationship with Airbnb, higher credits and stored value utilization, and Wallet becoming the platform on which future financial products are built. A Typical Day Lead the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Wallet — defining what it means to give every Airbnb guest a financial home they trust and return to. Build the core Wallet experience: payment method management, spending power visibility (credits, stored value, refunds), and personalized financial communication. Drive engagement on Wallet surfaces during and between trips, making the product feel valuable and revisitable — not just a utility reached at checkout. Partner with Payments Engineering to expand the payment methods and financial capabilities available to guests across global markets. Collaborate closely with platform product managers who build the payment and financial infrastructure Wallet sits on — delegating capability work generously, staying aligned on shared roadmaps. Work closely with Checkout to ensure Wallet and payment setup reduce friction at the moment of booking. Design and run A/B experiments to optimize conversion and engagement, translating data into product decisions. Collaborate with Design to create guest-facing financial experiences that feel delightful and trustworthy. Work with Trust & Safety, Fraud, and Finance to ensure payment flows are secure and compliant globally. Define goals with clearly measurable OKRs and build cross-functional and executive alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, and Legal. Inspire teams and leadership to support a long-term Wallet vision that grows from a financial hub into a platform for new guest financial products. Your Expertise 8+ years of product management experience, with deep experience building consumer-facing wallet, stored value, or digital financial products. Proven track record making a financial product feel engaging and valuable beyond a utility — can speak to retention, return visits, and active engagement metrics. Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem: card networks, digital wallets, BNPL/installments, local payment methods, and emerging payment rails. Experience shipping payment method expansions or new payment capabilities at consumer scale. Demonstrated success driving checkout or transaction conversion improvements through experimentation and data-driven iteration. Strong design sensibility; experience partnering closely with design teams to make financial UX feel trustworthy, personalized, and proactively useful. A collaborative working style with platform product teams — comfortable delegating capability work to partners and sharing ownership of integrations. Demonstrated success building cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Design, Finance, Legal, and Payments

jobs.description: Product Jobs / Senior Product Manager Posted 5 days ago Acquia Senior Product Manager 5 day week Great Place to Work '25 Remote · Canada Job Description About Acquia About Acquia Acquia empowers the world’s most ambitious brands to create digital customer experiences that matter. With open source Drupal at its core, the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) enables marketers, developers, and IT operations teams at thousands of global organizations to rapidly compose and deploy digital products and services that engage customers, enhance conversions, and help businesses stand out. Headquartered in Boston, MA, Acquia is a Great Place to Work-CertifiedTM company, is listed as one of the world’s top software companies by The Software Report, and is positioned as a market leader by the analyst community. We are Acquia. We are building for the future and we want you to be a part of it! Career Exploration at Acquia Our recruitment process is designed to empower you in making the most informed decisions. Acquia is committed to providing an inclusive, transparent, efficient, and educational interview experience that cultivates exploration into career opportunities at Acquia You will discover the opportunity to grow your career here and learn from a global team that empowers you to exceed boundaries and achieve the extraordinary. Acquia is seeking a Senior Product Manager for Acquia Agent Experience . Your goal will be to enable an AI agent to do anything on our platform a person can do, within the permissions it is granted. Are you a product manager who builds with agentic tools yourself? Do you want to define how people delegate work to agents, from prompt to production, on the platform that powers the world's most ambitious websites? Then join us. Expectations of the Role You will work on the experience for two users at once: the person directing an agent, and the agent doing the work. You will help define how agents move from advising, to acting, to resolving issues on their own, always inside the governance a customer sets: assigned roles, human approval, a full audit trail, and one-click rollback. You will report to the VP for Acquia's AgentX and DevX and drive your part of that roadmap. This is a builder's role. You will not only write specifications; you will use agentic coding tools to prototype the experience yourself, put it in front of engineering and stakeholders, and ship. Writing is central to the job: you connect business leaders and engineering squads, and much of that connection is the document you write and the demo you build. Job Responsibilities Shape vision and strategy: Help shape the product vision for Acquia Agent Experience, and contribute to it rather than wait to receive it. Make the case for where agents create the most customer value next. Build, don't just brief: Use agentic coding tools to prototype flows, draft specs with your agent, and produce working demos. A running prototype settles a debate faster than a deck. Communicate and evangelize: Present the vision, roadmap, and value to customers, partners, and executives. Write clearly enough that a reader needs no meeting to understand you, and hold your own in the room when the meeting happens anyway. Develop collaboratively: Partner with other disciplines and departments to deliver features that improve the experience from prompt to production. Be the glue between teams. When a service you depend on breaks, help fix it instead of waiting for another team to get to it. Manage the backlog: Prioritize high-impact work, from agent governance to autonomous issue resolution, and ship it on time with measurable value. Write clear specifications: Develop product requirements and acceptance criteria. Direct an agent to find or draft reference docs when none exist, then work with the owning team to review and revise. Lead the lifecycle: Guide cross-functional teams through the full product lifecycle, moving capabilities from experimental open-source and internal projects into supported Acquia AI features. Decide with data: Track adoption, agent action volume, and customer outcomes. Optimize for customer value, and say so plainly when a better model or more capacity would unblock that value now. Hold the standards: Hold the experience to Acquia's bar for security, compliance, and governance, so a customer can hand an agent real work and trust the controls around it. Skills Ownership and agency: You feel accountable for the outcome and take pride in the craft of shipping it, not just the plan. You do not wait to be told, you do not stay boxed in your own scope, and you escalate blockers early rather than sit stuck. You thrive with high autonomy and treat ambiguity as the job, not an obstacle. Agentic fluency: You keep yourself at the front of agentic tools and practices and adopt them in your daily work. You can say what today's agents do well, where they fail, and how that changes what Acquia should build. Curiosity and building instinct: Y
