Job Title

Universal Distribution Manager – Product Marketing

Summary 

The Universal Distribution Manager plays a pivotal role in shaping and accelerating the medium- to long-term growth strategy of Amadeus Universal Distribution. Positioned at the intersection of strategy, product, and business model innovation, this role partners closely with senior stakeholders and has direct exposure to key decision-makers across Travel Distribution. 

The role drives strategic analyses and business model definition for Universal Distribution initiatives. It is responsible for identifying strategic opportunities and risks, challenging assumptions, and translating complex Universal Distribution initiatives into clear, actionable recommendations that influence executive decision-making. 

 

Working in a highly collaborative and matrixed environment, the Universal Distribution Manager influences cross-functional decisions and partners with Product Management, Strategy, Commercial Finance, Engineering, and Commercial teams to shape the future of travel distribution. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Analysis  

  • Define and deliver high-impact strategic studies on the most critical and complex topics shaping the future of Universal Distribution and Travel Distribution more broadly. 

  • Shape and frame the key strategic questions for Travel Distribution leadership — including business model evolution, ecosystem dynamics, and platform economics. 

  • Enable evidence-based decisions, including prioritization of initiatives, investment sequencing, and identification of “no-regret” moves versus optional bets. 

  • Represent Product Marketing and Universal Distribution in internal strategy forums and executive checkpoints, ensuring alignment and consistency of narrative. 

2. Universal Distribution Business Model 

  • Own the definition, evolution and recommendation of the Universal Distribution business model, influencing strategic decisions across Travel Distribution. 

  • Define and structure key business models and transition paths, in close collaboration with Product, Strategy, and Commercial, and Finance teams. 

3. Universal Distribution Business Case, Pricing & Monetization 

  • Lead the development, consolidation, and validation of Universal Distribution business cases. 

  • Ensure assumptions, risks, market dynamics, and value drivers are robust, clearly articulated, and supported by data. 

  • Recommend pricing and monetization strategies and drive executive alignment on commercial approaches for Universal Distribution initiatives. 

4. Cross–Business Unit Collaboration & Ecosystem Alignment 

  • Work closely with other Amadeus Business Units (e.g., Outpayce, Hotel, Ailine IT and other domains) on Universal Distribution initiatives that span multiple portfolios. 

  • Ensure alignment of strategy, value proposition, and business models across the Business Units involved. 

  • Act as a bridge between Travel Distribution and adjacent Amadeus businesses, contributing to integrated, end-to-end Universal Distribution solutions. 

About the Ideal Candidate 

  • University degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or Information Technology; a Master of Business Administration or eq

Unsere Kunden lieben die Flexibilität, mobil oder über das WLAN in allen Räumen und mit allen Geräten ihre Unterhaltung genießen zu können. Die Aufnahme-, Pause- und Restart-Funktion bietet zusätzlich eine Unabhängigkeit von starren Sendezeiten. Damit im Hintergrund alles reibungslos funktioniert, müssen Zahlungen verarbeitet, Abonnements verwaltet, Business-Partner abgerechnet, Betrugsversuche erkannt und aussagekräftige Reports erstellt werden. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Wir suchen keinen klassischen Finance-Experten. Wir suchen jemanden, der komplexe Prozesse versteht, gerne analytisch arbeitet und Spaß daran hat, gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklern intelligente Lösungen zu entwickeln. Wenn Du Geschäftsprozesse lieber neu denkst als verwaltest und Daten für Dich mehr sind als Tabellen, solltest Du weiterlesen. Deine Mission Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Technology und Data. Gemeinsam mit Finance, Business Intelligence, Engineering und unseren Softwarepartnern entwickelst Du unsere Business-Systeme rund um Payments und Revenue kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei sorgst Du dafür, dass Prozesse einfacher, intelligenter und stärker automatisiert werden und wir jederzeit auf verlässliche Daten und Kennzahlen vertrauen können. Das erwartet Dich Prozesse gestalten statt verwalten Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, hinterfragst etablierte Abläufe und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen effizientere, skalierbare und automatisierte Lösungen. Business und Technologie verbinden Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen, entwickelst daraus Lösungskonzepte und stimmst deren Umsetzung mit unseren Engineering-Teams und externen Softwarepartnern ab. Daten intelligent nutzen Gemeinsam mit unserem BI-Team entwickelst Du KPIs, Reports und Dashboards. Wenn Du Freude daran hast, erstellst Du Analysen auch selbst – beispielsweise mit BigQuery oder Tableau. Automatisierung vorantreiben Du identifizierst manuelle Abläufe, entwickelst Automatisierungskonzepte und begleitest deren Umsetzung. About the Role

HelloFresh has spent nearly fifteen years perfecting the home cooking experience, and is now extending that expertise beyond the weekly meal kit to become a daily kitchen companion for any home cook — from the first scroll of inspiration to the moment you plate your meal. You will lead the Engagement tribe, which focuses on deepening customers' relationships with our brands, is the driving force behind this shift. It's a highly visible mandate with sustained attention from senior leadership.

The tribe's work spans three connected domains, each driving a distinct part of our growth engine. For the daily Discovery and Cooking Experience, our goal is habit formation. We are building a large, top-of-funnel audience by ensuring the HelloFresh app supports users through every step of getting a weeknight dinner on the table, regardless of whether they're ordering our meal kits. In parallel, our Loyalty and Referral domains are focused on direct, immediate commercial impact. A modern loyalty program deepens our relationship with subscribers to directly increase retention and lifetime value, while viral mechanics turn our most enthusiastic users into our most efficient acquisition channel.

You will own the vision and multi-year strategy across these domains, but your mandate is also to set a new standard for how we build AI-enabled products and how our teams operate. The job is as much about growing the PMs around you and raising the bar of the practice as it is about the strategy itself.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap across the tribe's full surface area: the daily discovery and cooking experience, loyalty, referrals, and other viral mechanics that drive organic growth.
  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of ~4 Directors and Associate Directors and their respective squads (including Principal PMs), meeting each where they are and raising the standard of product thinking, experimentation, and execution across the tribe.
  • Manage a hybrid operating environment: you will guide traditional squads delivering core product value, while simultaneously directing a specialized "startup" squad mandated to break existing processes, pioneer AI-enabled workflows, and act as a rapid-iteration incubator.
  • Set the prioritization framework that balances the milestones moving the business near-term against the bets that pay off over a longer horizon
  • Own the tribe's key results across a diverse funnel: daily active users and habit formation (top-of-funnel discovery), increased LTV and retention (loyalty), and direct conversions (referral-driven acquisition). You will build the metric framework that connects these varied customer behaviors to concrete commercial outcomes.
  • Partner with the tribe's engineering and design leadership as a true peer, jointly owning what gets built and how the teams deliver
  • Work hand-in-hand with marketing and CRM on program communications, reward economics, and commercial strategy, and own external vendor relationships where they exist — evaluating partnerships continuously and deciding where we build versus buy
  • Act as the strategic sparring partner for senior and C-level leadership, communicating direction, defending tradeoffs, and owning the results — these products get weekly executive attention
  • Set the tone on how the tribe works: fast, iterative, experiment-first. We ship a small version in a week and learn, rather than spending a quarter on a plan before anything is real

What You'll Bring

  • A track record of building B2C products at scale and the teams that build them — you've managed and developed product managers
  • Experience leading a scaled organization of product managers and the cross-functional teams around them
  • Experience in food, or in another category people feel a genuine personal connection to — the kind of product people choose because they love it, not because they have to
  • Customer-obsessed product taste and judgment: you start from customer behavior rather than leading with technology alone, forming a clear point of view and making confident calls without waiting for perfect data.
  • A bias toward iterative delivery, quick decisions, and short timelines
  • Executive presence: you're comfortable presenting to C-level stakeholders, holding your own with tough senior leadership, defending strategic tradeoffs, and operating at that level of visibility
  • Experience working with marketing and CRM counterparts as close collaborators

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
jobs.location: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Cyprus; London, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Munich, Cyprus; Prague, Czech Republic; Remote, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia
jobs.description:
You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Day to day, you will:

  • Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
  • Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
  • Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
  • Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on. 
  • Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
  • Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
  • Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

What you’ll bring

  • A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
  • Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
  • The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
  • Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
  • A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
  • An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
  • A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.

What you’ll need

  • Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
  • The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
  • Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
  • A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
  • Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
  • As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.

What success looks like

Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists. You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedu

If you like solving genuinely hard problems, bringing clarity to complex environments and building products that have visible business impact - this is the role for you!

Your primary job is to help Liberis's commercial decision makers understand the small businesses we serve and how they consider, use and perform across our product range. Doing this well requires a clear conceptual model of the business and a willingness to engage with stakeholders across the business, as well as taste and customer empathy in developing a great insights product including dashboards, insight tools and self-serve capabilities.

You will run prioritisation, manage the backlog and make decisions about where effort goes. You will also spend a meaningful amount of time in the detail, reviewing data models and dashboards, asking hard questions about definitions, and making sure what we ship is accurate and trusted.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

jobs.title: Go-To-Market Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The GTM Tooling team owns the systems, tools, and standards that let GetYourGuide’s commercial teams move faster with less friction—turning everyday platform pain points into scalable, self-serve capabilities. 
We’re the connective tissue between Sales, Business Operations, and technology, using AI and smart process design to create leverage rather than manage chaos.

Your mission

  • Connect the business to the platform: Be the voice of Sales when the platform gets in their way, turning feedback and challenges into real opportunities for improvement, while championing GYG's Salesforce process documentation as our organization evolves.

  • Help shape the GTM tooling roadmap: As part of the GTM Tooling team, contribute to defining and driving the roadmap - spotting patterns in Sales needs, translating them into prioritized initiatives, and partnering with GTM colleagues to land changes with the right governance and enablement so they stick.

  • Scale support without scaling headcount: Build AI-assisted, self-serve tools that empower the sales team to solve everyday platform issues on their own, and own end-user administration — access, roles, reviews, and cleanups — making the routine effortless.

  • Make data accessible: Equip the sales team with the tools, templates, and standards to answer their own data questions with confidence, and govern the reporting environment — structure, naming, and access — so self-service reporting stays consistent and trustworthy.

  • Keep the knowledge alive: Curate the Salesforce System Wiki in Confluence so reps and managers can find answers without asking, and triage questions across internal channels, tracking them in JIRA through to resolution.

Your toolkit

  • 4+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar role in a B2B or marketplace environment.
  • Solid Salesforce experience: comfortable with user administration, reports, dashboards, and data, but no expectation to build Flows or manage deployments.

jobs.description:
You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Day to day, you will:

  • Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
  • Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
  • Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
  • Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on. 
  • Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
  • Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
  • Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

What you’ll bring

  • A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
  • Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
  • The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
  • Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
  • A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
  • An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
  • A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.

What you’ll need

  • Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
  • The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
  • Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
  • A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
  • Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
  • As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.

What success looks like

Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists. You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

Ethernet connection strongly preferred because it provides the most consistent call quality. (Usually requires only an inexpensive cable you plug into your desktop/laptop and modem.) Minimum [10] Mbps download / [5] Mbps upload of dedicated bandwidth, with latency under ~150ms, jitter under ~30ms, and packet loss under ~1% . If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Apply today and work with a very different type of company. #li-remote

jobs.description: As Scalable Capital rapidly expands its product offering, we are setting up a fundamentally new, state-of-the-art Anti Financial Crime (AFC) platform. In this role, you will make critical, strategic decisions to lay the technical and architectural foundation for this greenfield ecosystem. This is a high-impact position with immense visibility: the platform is pivotal to Scalable Capital’s regulatory compliance and security posture, ensuring that every product and feature we launch is bulletproof against financial crime attack vectors. You will collaborate closely with our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Anti Financial Crime (AFC) Operations teams. Taking functional ownership, you will be responsible for the developments of a dedicated engineering team primarily consisting of Data Engineers. We encourage creative, proactive problem-solving: you will analyze potential attack vectors across Scalable’s platform and determine the most secure, efficient, and scalable methodologies to mitigate them. Rather than operating a legacy system, you will architect and build this platform from the beginning, acting as its overall owner. You will have access to cutting-edge technologies and a dedicated engineering team to address these complex challenges. In an era defined by AI and rapid tech acceleration, we are looking for a smart, creative problem solver who prioritizes execution speed alongside diligence to eliminate regulatory risks and automate workflows. Key Responsibilities Greenfield Tooling Development: Lead the functional definition and technical implementation of a brand-new, end-to-end Anti Financial Crime tooling ecosystem. Product Enablement & Security: Act as the dedicated Product Manager for Scalable’s Anti Financial Crime domain. Ensure that every new product launch and feature rollout is resilient and bulletproof against financial crime. Requirements Discovery & Synthesis: Work collaboratively with 2nd-line AML and AFC control functions to translate complex regulatory and threat-mitigation requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications, enabling the engineering team to execute seamlessly. Threat Prevention & Detection: Partner with AML and AFC departments to continuously model, prevent, and detect suspicious or unlawful activities across Scalable’s expanding platform. Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate closely with peer Product Managers across our Broker, Wealth, Credit, and Banking offerings to ensure seamless integration of AFC controls into all user journeys and product workflows. Technical Roadmap Ownership: Take full ownership of the AFC product roadmap and system architecture, working hand-in-hand with a large team of Engineers to design robust, scalable solutions on top of our data lake and newly built infrastructure. Execution Speed & Diligence: Drive end-to-end product delivery, from technical evaluation to production release, balancing high execution velocity with absolute accuracy and meticulous attention to detail. Agile Milestone Management: Apply agile frameworks to drive development, shifting from rigid sprint commitments to milestone steering and prioritization to maintain adaptability under changing conditions. Product Management Experience: Solid background in product management, ideally with exposure to technical platforms, financial services, fintech, data engineering, or anti-financial crime and regulatory environments. Creativity, Agility and Domain Expertise: Prior experience in Anti-Money Laundering, Fraud Prevention, Data Engineering, or Regulatory Technology is highly beneficial, but not mandatory. In the age of AI, we value creativity, fast learning, and intelligent problem-solving over years of domain expertise. Technical & Analytical Affinity: Strong technical aptitude and analytical mindset required to collaborate effectively with a dedicated engineering team, understand complex data architectures, as well as machine learning and pattern detection basics. Diligence & Velocity: Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the proven ability to dissect complex financial crime frameworks into clear, step-by-step technical requirements while executing with high velocity. Stakeholder Alignment: Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to harmonize and align a diverse group of stakeholders across engineering, operations, product management, and regulatory control functions. Agile Mindset: Proficient with modern agile collaboration tools and comfortable navigating fast-paced, high-visibility task forces or firefighting environments. Language: Professional fluency in English; German is considered an advantage but is not mandatory. You will lead the strategy to move from siloed AI solutions to a unified, compliant, and robust internal "AI as a Platform" offering. You will work closely with a dedicated cross-functional team of Data Scientists, AI Engineers and Software Engineers, acting as the key bridge between the technical development, internal domain teams, and regulatory stakeholders to ensure AI is integrated and leveraged effectively, securely, and ethically. Key Responsibilities Platform Strategy & Ownership: Define, prioritize, and own the strategic roadmap for our internal "AI as a Platform", ensuring it provides robust, scalable, and easy-to-integrate services for all internal domain and product teams, enabling them to consume AI capabilities without requiring them to integrate with external APIs. Identify Opportunities: Work in close collaboration with all internal domain and product teams to identify opportunities to employ AI capabilities, focusing on: Client Experience: Enhancing core client-facing product functionality through predictive modeling and personalization. Operational Efficiency: Improving internal system scalability, fraud detection, and overall operational performance. Use Case Implementation: Drive the implementation of strategic AI use cases across the company. Ensure efficient implementation by aligning implementation timelines across all teams involved (AI platform, domain teams, mobile,...). AI Compliance & Governance: Act as the key product driver for AI compliance, regulatory adherence, and ethical usage. Define our approach to ensure all models and data usage are secure and compliant with current and emerging data protection laws. Hier lernst Du in unserem 18-monatigen Programm unseren globalen Operations Products & Processes-Bereich kennen, mit besonderem Fokus auf digitale Transformation. Unser Ziel ist es, die Kernprozesse rund um die Vermietung in unserem globalen SIXT Stationsnetzwerk zu digitalisieren und zu automatisieren. Du gestaltest aktiv digitale Customer Journeys mit, optimierst digitale Touchpoints und trägst dazu bei, nahtlose End-to-End-Kundenerlebnisse über die digitalen Kanäle zu schaffen. Dadurch reduzierst Du die Komplexität im Arbeitsalltag und ermöglichst unseren Kund/innen einen reibungslosen digitalen Vermietungsprozess. Gleichzeitig baust Du Dir ein wertvolles Netzwerk zu Fachabteilungen und Führungskräften im ganzen Unternehmen auf. Interesse? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und starte zum 01.10.2026 als Trainee Global Operations Products & Processes (m/w/d) bei SIXT! DEINE ROLLE BEI SIXT Du durchläufst ein spannendes 18-monatiges Traineeprogramm, das Dich durch den globalen Operations Products & Processes-Bereich bei SIXT führt – von Digital Rent Experience über Mobility Operations und Fleet & Turnaround – alles ist dabei! Du arbeitest aktiv an digitalen Transformationsprojekten mit und treibst die Digitalisierung des gesamten Kundenflows voran – von der Online-Buchung über Self-Service-Lösungen bis zur digitalen Rückgabe Du analysierst und optimierst digitale Customer Journeys, identifizierst Pain Points in digitalen Prozessen und entwickelst datenbasierte Lösungen zur Verbesserung des digitalen Kundenerlebnisses. Weiterhin arbeitest Du an der Implementierung digitaler Tools und Prozesse, die unsere Stationen unterstützen und manuelle Arbeitsschritte reduzieren – von App-Features bis zu automatisierten Backend-Prozessen Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Tech-Teams, Produktmanagement und Operations und stellst sicher, dass die Lösungen die Bedürfnisse unserer Kund/innen und Stationsmitarbeitenden erfüllen Du absolvierst verschiedene Trainings (Soft und Hard Skills), lernst Führungskräfte aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen kennen und entwickelst ein funktions- und bereichsübergreifendes Netzwerk Du wirst in Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung von Anfang an mit einem individuellen Entwicklungsplan und einem Mentor (m/w/d) unterstützt DEINE FÄHIGKEITEN ZÄHLEN Studium Du hast ein Studium in Business, TUM-BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Ein technischer Background oder Kenntnisse in digitalen Produkten sind von Vorteil Erfahrung Du verfügst über erste praktische Erfahrungen durch Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten in den Bereichen Digitalisierung, Digital Product Management, UX/UI, Prozessautomatisierung, digitale Customer Experience oder verwandten digitalen Projekten Digital Mindset Du bringst eine Affinität für digitale Technologien mit, verstehst digitale Geschäftsmodelle und hast idealerweise bereits mit agilen Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) gearbeitet Soft Skills Du überzeugst durch Drive, Ambition und Neugier, zeichnest Dich durch eine proaktive und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus und hast ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen für datenbasierte Entscheidungen Sprachen Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil WAS WIR DIR BIETEN Extra-Vorteile Profitiere von Rabatten auf SIXT rent, share, ride und SIXT+, attraktiven Fahrzeugleasing-Angeboten sowie exklusiven Deals bei Partnern für Reisen, Technik, Fashion und mehr AI Excellence Mit Claude by Anthropic und SIXTgpt, unserer eigenen AI Plattform, arbeitest Du vom ersten Tag an mit modernsten AI Tools. Wir geben Dir den Freiraum, neue Technologien auszuprobieren, Dein Know-how kontinuierlich auszubauen und AI gezielt einzusetzen, um schneller, smarter und mit mehr Impact zu arbeiten Mobilitätspower Du erhältst von uns einen monatlichen Zuschuss als Beitrag zu Deiner individuellen Mobilität Zukunftsplus Wir fördern Deine Altersvorsorge und unterstützen Dich bei kapitalbildenden Leistungen, damit Du optimal abgesichert bist Feel-Good-Atmosphäre Bleib aktiv mit unserem modernen SIXT Fitnessstudio, vielfältigen Freizeitangeboten wie dem Gaming-Bereich oder dem SIXT-Chor und genieße unser hochwertiges Mitarbeiterrestaurant Flexibilität Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit flexiblen Zeiten Herzenssache Nimm Dir jedes Jahr einen Tag Zeit, um Dich ehrenamtlich in einer karitativen Einrichtung einzubringen, die sich für das Wohl von Kindern engagiert Über uns: Wir sind ein weltweit führender Mobilitätsdienstleister mit einem Umsatz von 4,00 Milliarden Euro und rund 9.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit. jobs.description: Engineering Jobs / Golang Engineer - SRE Engineering Productivity Posted about 1 month ago Arista Networks Golang Engineer - SRE Engineering Productivity 5 day week Comparably Best WLB '25 Remote · Ireland Job Description About Arista Networks Company Description Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges. At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We  believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation. Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do. Job Description Who You’ll Work With Working in Engineering Productivity (EngProd), you will collaborate and work with other engineers to design, build, scale, and operate the systems that the rest of Arista’s development teams use. The EngProd team uses industry-standard systems like Ansible, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Grafana, Spinnaker, MySQL, ElasticSearch, Google Cloud, and Varnish and also internal systems that we’ve built from the ground-up to automate CI/CD, testing, analysis, and visualization. We believe observability is one of the cornerstones of a stable system, and endeavor to make sure we can monitor and visualize all aspects of our tooling and infrastructure. Arista Software Engineering roles demand a strong and broad software engineering background. While the primary focus area for this role is EngProd, the role will not be limited to any single aspect of software development at Arista. It will cover all aspects of software development spanning the addition of new features, debugging problems and fine tuning code for scalability and performance. You will own your projects from definition to deployment and customer interactions, and you will be responsible for the quality of everything you deliver. Arista Software Engineering prides itself on a supportive and growth oriented culture. Over time, as your interests change, coupled with evolving business needs you will have the opportunity to switch from EngProd to other areas, if you like. What You’ll Do Review and contribute to the specifications and implementations written by other team members. Design and develop features, feature tests and solutions. Fix bugs and refactor code as needed. Work with Arista’s software engineers to identify bottlenecks and limitations in our workflows, tooling, and infrastructure and provide fixes for those problems. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. jobs.title: Senior CFD Analyst
jobs.department: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Maneuver Dominance Engineering : MD - ME
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is seeking a Senior Computational Fluid Dynamics Analyst to join the Maneuver Dominance team in our London office. The Maneuver Dominance (MD) Team at Anduril develops autonomous aerial robotic systems designed to operate in large coordinated teams in concert with ground maneuver forces. We are chartered to add to Anduril’s list of successful aerial drone platforms like Ghost, Altius, or Roadrunner.

Here you will work on core product development for unmanned rotorcraft and complex systems, including but not limited to analysis and development of a novel payload carriage and release system, analysis and testing of the system. The ideal candidate would be practical, hands-on and a self starter with high growth potential.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own and drive the aerodynamic analysis of the payload carriage and release system for a novel aircraft type.
  • Use first principles as a basis for every decision and discern the right level of analysis to apply. Apply and execute progressively more complex analysis methods (hand calculations, spreadsheet, MATLAB and ANSYS/STAR-CCM+ models) as appropriate to the situation.
  • Develop appropriate computational models and simulations to predict aircraft performance, flight dynamics, rotor dynamics, aerodynamic loads and payload safe separation as needed to meet design schedules.
  • Work in collaboration with Mechanical Design, Stress Engineers, Actuation Engineers and Airframe Architects to create and refine design solutions based on best practice.
  • Participate in technical efforts to define requirements, propose solutions, and establish a methodology for evaluating and verifying system design from an aerodynamic perspective. This will involve close collaboration with partner organizations, in both the UK and US.
  • Support the design, instrumentation, execution and data processing of tests to validate models and predictions.
  • Actively contribute to the enhancement of team tools, templates, processes, and standards.
  • Cultivate a positive, dedicated, educational, and enjoyable collaborative work environment.
  • Travel to test sites and vendors to support development test activities as needed.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BEng, BSc, MEng, MSc or higher in mechanical or aerospace engineering, or equivalent work experience.
  • 10+ years in a technical engineering role in a professional aerospace setting, with demonstrated track record of successful stakeholder management, consensus building and successful project delivery.
  • Strong proficiency in CFD software (ANSYS or STAR-CCM+ preferred) solution sequences for linear and non-linear analyses.
  • Experience in NX/Teamcenter and proficiency in CAD software.
  • Proficiency in Matlab or Python (or equivalent) for developing analytical models, data acquisition, and automation.
  • Strong technical knowledge in core CFD principles and the ability to apply them to real-world engineering problems; using the Navier-Stokes equations, discretization, mesh generation, URANS, RANS, LES and DES, setting boundary and initial conditions, using solvers to achieve solution convergence and numerical stability and verifying and validating your model predictions.
  • Hands-on experience developing CFD modelling and analysis tooling which is flexible, expandable and reliable.
  • An excellent communicator, experienced in report writing and the development and delivery of presentations across a range of settings.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.K. security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with development and analysis of payload carriage and release systems.
  • Experience in developing tooling for safe separation analysis.
  • Experience in rotorcraft CFD analysis.
  • Demonstrated passion for aviation, aerospace, and/or unmanned systems.
  • Outstanding leadership and interpersonal skills.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation

Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
 
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You'll Do:

CoreWeave’s Monolith team is building the essential cloud platform for AI innovators, applying machine learning to solve previously intractable physics and engineering challenges. We operate at the intersection of advanced cloud infrastructure and applied data science, transforming how complex industrial products - such as automotive systems, aircraft, and advanced batteries - are conceived, tested, and developed.

About the role: 

As a Staff Product Manager, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one of the core components of our platform. We're rebuilding the platform from the ground up, so you'll shape the product from day one. You'll drive execution across Research, Data Science, and Forward Deployed Engineering to ship features that span agentic experiences to enterprise integrations. You will work closely with enterprise customers to understand complex engineering workflows, turn field signals into platform improvements, and mentor other product managers across the organisation while setting a high bar for technical depth and customer empathy.

Who You Are:

  • 7+ years of product management experience with a strong track record working on complex, data-driven products and enterprise systems.
  • High versatility with a proven ability to work across multiple technical domains (e.g., ML modelling, agentic workflows, cloud infrastructure, or data engineering).
  • Strong technical fluency with the ability to confidently discuss APIs, architecture diagrams, deployment models, and platform trade-offs with engineers.
  • Demonstrated cross-functional leadership, skilled at aligning diverse teams, managing technical dependencies, and balancing constraints with business objectives.
  • Deep customer empathy with a curiosity for diagnosing friction points for both external engineering users and internal forward-deployed teams.
  • Absolute execution focus with a proven ability to build clarity out of ambiguity, maintain high attention to detail, and drive initiatives from concept through delivery.

Preferred:

  • Background in engineering, physical research, or applied data science (e.g., hands-on experience running physical tests, analysing sensor data, or working in a lab environment).
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or CoreWeave.
  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools; our PMs are builders first and regularly ship code to production.

Wondering if you're a good fit? 

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.

  • You love to build clarity out of complexity and champion high-impact technical products from concept to launch.
  • You're curious about emerging Physical AI technologies, agentic workflows, and how they can be applied to transform real-world industrial challenges.
  • You're an expert in cross-functional execution, seamlessly connecting the dots between deeply technical engineering teams and commercial priorities.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer | 7taps
jobs.description: About 7taps 7taps is a training delivery platform built for the way people actually absorb information: short, sharp, and on-the-go. Enterprise teams use it to reach their whole workforce and prove the training got done. Its customers are major enterprises like Amazon and Tesla: organizations where people need to learn something, retain it, and actually apply it. The product started as a simple flashcard tool and has evolved into a full infrastructure layer for corporate training: multi-channel delivery (SMS, WhatsApp, Teams, Slack, email, QR), course creation, and completion analytics that show exactly who finished, without forcing anyone to log in. The design team is small and strong. You'd be the fourth designer, embedded directly in the product process. The platform is web-only, and the design problem is two-sided. On one side, admins running campaigns for tens of thousands of employees, with bulk operations and permissions where one wrong click matters. On the other, the people taking those courses. They're at office desks, on warehouse floors, out in the field. Some live in software all day, some barely touch it. Both sides have to work. What you are expected to do: Own product design end-to-end: from early concept to shipped feature with a high degree of autonomy. Design systems and flows: coherent product architecture across a complex multi-sided platform (course creators, learners, admins, analytics). Collaborate closely with engineers and the broader team to define and validate product hypotheses. Work within an existing design system and help it evolve. Move fast: the team pivots frequently, tests hypotheses fast, and discards what doesn't work — you'll be part of that rhythm. Communicate your thinking clearly in synchronous settings: be the person in the call who can sketch a solution on the fly, take feedback, and iterate immediately. What you need to succeed: You think in systems and design coherent experiences, finding the shortest path to the right structure. You drive tasks to completion on your own, without hand-holding. You communicate ideas and trade-offs clearly, so non-designers can follow your thinking. You thrive in a fast hypothesis-test-discard cadence and stay steady when work gets shelved. You have real enterprise B2B intuition: bulk operations, safeguards, admin workflows, and permissions, where one wrong click can affect 50,000 employees. Your visual craft is solid enough to work within the existing design system. You speak Russian; English is a plus. What you get: Real ownership — a small design team means your decisions actually shape the product, not just a corner of it. Enterprise-scale impact — your work reaches thousands of learners through major corporate clients in the USA. Focused, talented team — no layers, no politics. Direct collaboration with a design lead who has been building this product from day one. AI-native environment — tools like Claude are part of the daily workflow, not a novelty or a side experiment. International context — the market is the US and the team is mixed and international. You'll get real cross-cultural, global product experience. "7taps is doing something genuinely interesting — micro-learning that enterprise teams actually adopt and use at scale. The design challenge here is real: building systems that work for both the people creating the training and the people receiving it. For a designer who thinks in systems and wants real product ownership in a lean, smart team, this is a rare fit." — Dasha Prokuda Design expert at hirehire Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, B2C
jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

As a Lead Product Manager in our Discovery (Traveler) organization, you will be a core part of a cross-functional mission team—partnering closely with engineering, design, research, data/analytics, and peer product leaders. 

Your mission

Your role is to set a clear product strategy and vision, translate it into measurable outcomes, and continuously iterate based on customer insights and data. While we care deeply about performance and metrics, we don’t optimize KPIs in isolation—we start from real traveler problems, validate them with evidence (qualitative and quantitative), and use measurement to ensure we’re delivering meaningful customer value.

We are looking for a leader who can think beyond the current product, champion the traveler perspective, and drive a compelling, coherent discovery experience across multiple surfaces. You’ll balance near-term impact with long-term systems thinking—building a strong learning agenda through experimentation and aligning cross-functional and cross-team stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs.

Successful PMs at GetYourGuide bring a growth mindset and deliver customer and business impact by identifying opportunities, building alignment, and executing with urgency.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for your product area, set clear, measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Drive sustained customer impact through a long-term (12 months+) roadmap, identifying areas for non-incremental impact.
  • Articulate and connect your product area’s strategy to the company’s mission. Break down the strategy into actionable steps, regularly update stakeholders on progress, and create excitement for your long-term vision. Build alignment across cross-functional teams, partner teams, and senior stakeholders.
  • Drive coherence across multiple discovery entry points (e.g., browse, landing pages, inspiration modules), balancing short-term wins with a durable information architecture and scalable content strategy.
  • Synthesize customer feedback, research insights, and business metrics to identify and prioritize the most meaningful traveler problems. Define success measures and iterate based on evidence to ensure we deliver real customer value. Make strategic decisions on sequencing and prioritizing product work to maximize impact and learning.
  • Build and execute an experimentation strategy—developing a robust hypothesis pipeline, defining guardrails and a learning agenda, and ensuring high-quality measurement. Use experiment outcomes to derive actionable insights, inform roadmap decisions, and align cross-team priorities and trade-offs.
  • Drive end-to-end delivery, ensuring high-quality execution from discovery through launch and iteration, and enabling effective collaboration across engineering, design, research, and data.
  • Build strong relationships and alignment across partner teams that influence discovery quality (e.g., Search, Recommendations, Brand/Content, Commercial). Set clear expectations, align on shared goals and trade-offs, and drive cross-functional execution against your roadmap.
  • Represent the traveler perspective at all levels, communicate decisions with clarity and transparency with your team, peers, and executive leadership. Coach PMs and cross-functional partners to raise the bar on product thinking and execution and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

Your toolkit

  • 6+ years of professional experience in product management and at least 2+ years as a Lead Product Manager.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead with customer problems and value creation, using data and metrics to validate impact rather than as the starting point.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a significant product area with responsibilities for strategy, KPI definition, goal-setting, and roadmap execution.
  • Ability to build alignment with a cross-functional mission team in a collaborative way that is aligned with our Guiding Principles.
  • Strong ability to lead in ambiguity, influence without authority, and align multiple teams around shared outcomes.

jobs.title: Associate Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Title

Associate Data Analyst

Summary

We're looking for a Data Governance Analyst to help ensure the quality, accuracy, and consistency of data across the Amadeus Hospitality Business Intelligence ecosystem. In this role, you'll work closely with business and technical teams to investigate data issues, maintain critical master data, support data governance initiatives, and drive continuous improvements that enhance the reliability of our products and services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure high standards of data quality across Hospitality BI products and systems.

  • Manage master data, including property updates, mappings, rebrands, and business identifiers.

  • Investigate, analyze, and resolve data quality issues in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with governance standards.

  • Use SQL and other analytical tools to research, troubleshoot, and monitor data.

  • Contribute to data governance initiatives, process improvements, and cross-functional projects that strengthen data management practices.

About the Ideal Candidate

  • Experience in the hospitality industry with a solid understanding of hospitality operations, terminology, and data.

  • Familiarity with Property Management Systems (PMS), reservations data, or other hospitality technology platforms.

  • Background in Data Governance, Data Quality, Master Data Management, Business Intelligence, Analytics, or a related field.

  • Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and troubleshooting; knowledge of BI and ETL processes is an advantage.

  • Understanding of databases, data warehousing, or data architecture concepts is a plus.

  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfortable collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders in a cross-functional environment.

  • Self-motivated, organized, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative setting.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in hospitality, data management, analytics, or a related discipline.

What We Can Offer You

  • 🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

  • 🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

  • 🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.

  • 🌟 A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.

  • 🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

  • 📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

  • 🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Fincrime Analyst (Relocation to Luxembourg)
jobs.description: Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office. About us Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn't stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives. By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need. What you'll be doing As our Fincrime Analyst, you’ll be the person who leads the surveillance, identification, and containment of real-time fraudulent and illicit activities across our ecosystem. Here's what your day-to-day will look like: High-Volume Alert Review & Resolution – Managing, analyzing, and resolving transaction monitoring alerts flagged by our systems, ensuring swift and accurate decision-making on complex or ambiguous customer behaviors. Advanced Escalation Handling – Serving as the primary point of contact for complex alerts escalated by other teams, conducting the necessary deep dives to quickly determine if further investigation or filing is required. Detection Logic Feedback Loop – Translating insights gained from your daily alert reviews into actionable feedback for Product and Data teams to help tune, refine, and update our transaction monitoring rules. Process & Workflow Optimization – Identifying bottlenecks in the daily alert handling queue and proposing tactical improvements to streamline workflows, reduce false positives, and increase team efficiency. Mentorship on the Line – Coaching and onboarding junior analysts by sharing best practices on transaction analysis, pattern recognition, and effective case documentation. Compliance & Airtight Documentation – Ensuring every resolved alert is backed by clear, concise, and defensible rationale that strictly adheres to regulatory standards and internal guidelines. Typology Hunting – Owning a strategic monitoring 'Focal Area', actively researching emerging global financial crime trends and swiftly translating them into live, production-ready transaction detection rules. Who we're looking for We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in! Does this sound like you? Experience – 3+ years of hands-on experience in transaction monitoring, real-time fraud operations, or KYT surveillance, specifically within hyper-growth Fintechs, fast-paced digital banking networks, or high-volume payment processing environments. Surveillance Mastery – Subject matter expertise in transaction monitoring principles, payment flows, velocity patterns, and regulatory frameworks (FATF, EU Directives, PSD3/SCA). Professional industry certifications (e.g., CAMS, CFE) are highly valued. Advanced Data & Systems Literacy – High proficiency in navigating complex data landscapes using internal data analytics tools (such as Looker, Splunk, HEX, or Redshift) and leveraging basic SQL to query and manipulate large transactional datasets. Rule Engineering Mindset – A strong track record of identifying structural gaps in automated detection models and turning those gaps into concrete, logic-driven monitoring scenarios. Leadership & Coaching Presence – Demonstrated ability to guide peers, design operational training modules, and elevate the monitoring and analytical competencies of a wider operational team. Analytical Communication – Exceptional ability to synthesize complex transaction data and chaotic payment behaviors into structured, clear, and actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Core Values – Extreme attention to detail, resilience under high transaction-alert volumes, and the unwavering ethical judgment needed to manage sensitive risk incidents. CareAbout: how we support your impact We move fast, and evolution never stops. It's a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we're committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That's why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health (Private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops) 💰 Financial resources (Stock Option Plan, Meal vouchers, Relocation support if you're moving countries) ⚙️ Growth and development (Professional development programs, Internal mobility, Language courses with Preply) 🌱 Flexibility (Unlimited PTO, Hybrid working policy*, Flexible working hours) 👨‍👩‍👧 Family (Enhanced parental leave, Additional leave for child sickness) *We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time. Equal opportunity employer At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager
jobs.description: About ScholarshipOwl ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation. We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered. The Role We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription. This is a high-impact, high-velocity role for someone who lives in the data, thrives on experimentation, and values action over perfection. You will be the architect of our growth. You’ll spend your days identifying leaks in the funnel, hypothesizing solutions, and working alongside a dedicated pod of engineers and designers to ship experiments that move the needle on revenue and retention. If you are a "full-stack" growth thinker who can move from a Mixpanel cohort analysis to a detailed technical spec this is the role for you. What You’ll Do Own the Conversion Engine: Take end-to-end responsibility for the user journey, optimizing every step from landing page registration to paywall conversion and subscription retention. Drive the Experiment Roadmap: Build, prioritize, and maintain a high-tempo experimentation backlog. You will use frameworks (like ICE or RICE) to ensure we are always working on the highest-leverage growth bets. Analyze & Diagnose: Monitor funnel and retention metrics daily in Mixpanel. You’ll identify exactly where users are dropping off and perform deep-dive discovery to understand the why . Ship with Velocity: Write precise product specs and acceptance criteria that allow engineering and design to execute independently. We prioritize shipping "good enough" tests today to get data, rather than waiting for "perfect" features next month. Optimize Revenue Levers: Design and run pricing, paywall, and offer optimization tests. You’ll also evaluate new growth levers like organic loops, landing page personalization, and winback programs. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Lead a dedicated pod of engineers and designers, maintaining strong working relationships with our dashboard and B2B teams to drive unified sprint priorities. Continuous Discovery: Conduct meaningful customer discovery interviews with our Gen-Z audience to uncover behavioral insights that data alone can’t show. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of Product Management experience , specifically in a Growth -focused role. Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests that resulted in measurable improvements to business KPIs (CVR, ARPU, Churn). Data Fluency: You are a power user of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar). You don't wait for a data analyst; you find the answers yourself. SaaS/Subscription Expertise: You understand the nuances of subscription models—trial-to-paid transitions, renewal cycles, and friction-point reduction. Technical Precision: Ability to write clear, "dev-ready" product specs and acceptance criteria. You understand technical trade-offs and how to scope an MVP. Mentoring & Leadership: A mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset with a desire to level up the broader team on growth methodologies and experimentation rigor. Gen-Z Empathy: You have an intuition for (or experience with) B2C products targeting younger audiences and understand their unique digital behaviors. Growth Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and the fact that 70% of experiments might fail—as long as we learn from them. Bonus Points: Experience with payment platforms (Stripe, Braintree) or Figma/prototyping tools. Knowledge of lifecycle/email marketing , SEO , and paid acquisition channels. Growth-focused certifications (e.g., Reforge). Background in EdTech or student-facing products. Why Join ScholarshipOwl? Mission-Driven Work – Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities. Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team. High Impact & Ownership – You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own the revenue engine. Unlimited PTO – We value results over hours worked and trust you to manage your time. Coworking Budget – $200/month to rent a coworking space. Hardware Budget – Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal computer. Continuous Learning Culture – We support curiosity, experimentation, and growth. Annual Company Off-sites – Connect with your teammates in person at various locations around the globe. Ready to move the needle? Apply now and show us how you’d build the future of student

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, Mobile focus
jobs.description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business. As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. KAYAK is seeking a Staff Product Designer, Mobile to own the design direction across our apps and lead the craft of every designer who works on them. This is a senior individual contributor role with manager-level scope: you carry the design direction and UX/UI patterns across three teams (Apps Meta, Apps Retention, and Mobile Design Systems) while still designing and shipping yourself. You set the quality bar for all Apps design output, you hold it across teams, and you keep engineering pointed at the right work. You are the technical lead for apps design, accountable for the quality and velocity of what the apps designers produce, without managing them directly. This role is required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week. In this role, you will: Own the design direction and the UX/UI pattern system across the apps surface. Navigation, mental models, and UI consistency cut across Apps Meta, Retention, and Design Systems at once, and you hold that cross-cutting direction so three teams ship one coherent experience rather than three versions of it. Set the quality standard for apps design and hold it as a discipline, not a project. Make the bar visible where teams miss it, and close gaps across teams that you did not personally create. You are accountable for the quality and velocity of all apps design output. Run planning and discovery for all three teams. Break multi-team, loosely defined problems into clear design direction the designers can run with. Partner with the Director of Product for Apps and the apps PMs on core initiatives, influencing roadmap and prioritization through design rationale. Lead native craft across iOS and Android. Set the approach for resizability, foldables, new screen sizes, and solve how KAYAK responds to platform chrome shifts like Liquid Glass and Material 3 Expressive. Lead the design approach for mobile AI features: how we integrate AI into the apps, the UI, and the navigation around it, so it lands as a native part of the experience. Drive the brand differentiation work for our portfolio of hero brands apps like momondo to ensure local market dominance. Raise the ceiling for the other apps designers through critique, shared standards, and patterns they build on. Designers should get better by working alongside you and using what you establish, not only through direct mentorship. Required Skills 10+ years in product design, with a portfolio of shipped, high-impact mobile work at consumer scale. Deep native expertise across iOS and Android. Mastery of Apple HIG and Material Design, and the judgment to know when to converge and when to honor platform difference. Hands-on experience with resizability, foldables, and iPad, and a point of view on platform chrome directions like Liquid Glass and Material 3 Expressive. A track record of raising design quality across a discipline beyond your own projects, through standards you set, critiques you ran, or systems others still use. Experience driving design direction across multiple teams or product areas, with the ability to influence without authority. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

SUMMARY

Wiz is looking for a Security Engineer for Product & Production Infrastructure who has experience performing security reviews, vulnerability management, and detection and response operations in cloud-native environments. You’ll get to collaborate with our software development and DevOps teams to secure Wiz’s products, CI/CD infrastructure, and production infrastructure. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence our product roadmap by utilizing Wiz-for-Wiz to assess, monitor, and harden our environments.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design and implement secure baselines for cloud resources and Kubernetes based infrastructure
  • Drive vulnerability management and remediation efforts – prioritizing issues, implementing mitigations, and designing strategic preventative controls in software supply chains from development through production
  • Extend our detection and response capabilities – building scalable solutions to identify malicious activity, triage alerts, and investigate and remediate incidents
  • Build deep functional partnerships with Wiz's engineering and operations teams – helping them deliver secure-by-design solutions

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Strong AWS cloud security experience (we will also consider equivalent experience in Azure and GCP with some level of AWS experience)
  • Cloud native Kubernetes services (EKS/GKE/AKS) and strong container security principles
  • Deep understanding of securing IAM and cloud identities at scale
  • Proven ability to lead technical security reviews of products and architectures, conduct threat modeling exercises, and translate findings into actionable security controls
  • Practical understanding of web application security concepts (such as OWASP Top-10 and similar)
  • Hands-on experience with IAC and related tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm, Pulumi)
  • Experience with automation and tooling development in one or more: Python, Go, Shell, HCL, Rego

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.description: Operations Jobs / Industry Engagement Analyst Posted 4 days ago ElectraLink Industry Engagement Analyst 4 × 8hr days 100% pay Hybrid · London or Nottingham Job Description About ElectraLink This role is suitable for a recent graduate or an individual early in career, as training will be provided. ElectraLink provides the Data Transfer Service (DTS) to energy market participants, which sends industry data flows through a trusted, central system. ElectraLink also runs the Distribution, Connection and Use of System Agreement (DCUSA) code. ElectraLink also develops APIs, creates energy data insights and contributes to projects for a changing energy system. The GB energy industry is going through unprecedented change as it moves to a net zero power system by 2030 and a net zero economy by 2050. Data and digitisation is becoming increasingly important to support this transition, with market participants and the regulator looking to make more use of data and make more data available. The purpose of this role is to support the Industry Engagement Leads by monitoring and analysing industry change with a focus on the industry code and regulatory policy space. This is predominantly an external-facing role including attendance at industry meetings and workgroups. The primary purpose of the role is to identify new not-for-profit services that ElectraLink could deliver; however, the role will also support the expansion of commercial and existing Cost Recovery Services. This is an excellent opportunity to develop a wide range of skills, whilst also learning about the energy industry in a period of significant regulatory change. What you'll do Help to maintain an industry change and policy prioritisation matrix Monitoring, analysing and prioritisation of energy industry code changes (eg: BSC, REC, CUSC and SEC) to identify opportunities or impacts on ElectraLink Work and co-ordinate with different teams within ElectraLink to understand impacts, views and position on industry code/policy changes Attend and provide input to internal work groups Consider new opportunities for ElectraLink either on a not-for-profit or commercial basis, and help to progress these through internal processes. Attend industry workgroups, forums and meetings as required and present ElectraLink’s views and positions. Your typical week may look like: Day 1: Review industry code or policy changes with Industry Engagement Lead – focusing on new changes and developments from the previous week. Update prioritisation matrix or create consultation summaries where required. Day 2: Attend external industry meeting and produce a short Day After Report highlighting key issues or impacts for ElectraLink.
